contracts.label: ActivePool
contracts.role: core: holds all collateral (ETH+WBTC) backing active troves

contracts.label: StabilityPool_ETH
contracts.role: core: ETH stability pool (DCHF deposits absorb ETH-trove liquidations)

contracts.label: StabilityPool_WBTC
contracts.role: core: WBTC stability pool (byte-identical to ETH SP)

contracts.label: TroveManager
contracts.role: core: trove state, liquidation, redemption; DCHF minter

contracts.label: TroveManagerHelpers
contracts.role: core: split-out trove math/liquidation helpers (called by TroveManager & others)

contracts.label: StabilityPoolManager
contracts.role: core: registry asset->stabilityPool

contracts.label: BorrowerOperations
contracts.role: core: open/adjust/close troves; DCHF minter

contracts.label: DefaultPool
contracts.role: core: holds redistributed collateral/debt from liquidations

contracts.label: CollSurplusPool
contracts.role: core: holds claimable collateral surplus after liquidation/redemption

contracts.label: DCHFToken
contracts.role: TARGET/token: CHF-pegged stablecoin; mint gated to TroveManager+BorrowerOperations

contracts.label: DfrancParameters
contracts.role: config: per-asset MCR/CCR/fees/gas-comp/min-debt/redemption-block

contracts.label: AdminContract
contracts.role: authority: adds collateral, deploys/registers stability pools, funds MON issuance

contracts.label: SortedTroves
contracts.role: core: sorted list of troves by ICR

contracts.label: CommunityIssuance
contracts.role: core: distributes MON rewards to stability providers

contracts.label: MONStaking
contracts.role: core: MON staking earns borrow/redemption fees

contracts.label: PriceFeed
contracts.role: oracle: per-asset Chainlink price x CHF index -> asset/CHF price

contracts.label: MONToken
contracts.role: token: MON governance/reward token (fixed supply, no mint)

contracts.label: WBTC
contracts.role: collateral token (canonical WBTC)

contracts.label: Safe_proxy_owner
contracts.role: AUTHORITY: 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe, owns nearly all core contracts + MON treasury

contracts.label: GnosisSafe_Singleton
contracts.role: authority impl: canonical Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 singleton

contracts.label: Chainlink_ETHUSD
contracts.role: oracle proxy: ETH/USD

contracts.label: Chainlink_BTCUSD
contracts.role: oracle proxy: BTC/USD

contracts.label: Chainlink_CHFUSD
contracts.role: oracle proxy: CHF/USD (peg index, shared by both assets)
